ORAL JUDGMENT

1 . The learned counsel for the appellants has filed a memo dated 13.08.2024 seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the appeal on the ground that due to oversight two appeals have been filed challenging the very same judgment and award dated 07.11.2018 passed by the MACT, Mysuru in MVC No.929/2015.
2.
The memo is placed on record.
3. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
